title: MCP update refuses a supplied evaluation_mode on other actions before effects
outcome: A supplied evaluation_mode reaches the store only through the evaluation_mode action; any other action refuses it up front instead of silently ignoring it, and the evaluate test pins the exact completed-work refusal
acceptance: the Note assertion in the verbs evaluate tests that accepted any non-unknown-mode error is tightened to the intended completed-work refusal

the mcp-dogfood suite passes an MCP regression in which update with action revise and a supplied evaluation_mode (blank and valid) is refused with invalid_argument before any effect, with the item revision, project feed, and focus unchanged, while update with action evaluation_mode still pins and clears

completion.summary: MCP update refuses a supplied evaluation_mode on any action other than evaluation_mode with invalid_argument before effects; the mcp-dogfood evaluated-policy test pins the valid and blank misroutes (show and focus unchanged) and the pin/clear positives through the CLI show text; the evaluate-word test's completed-work assertion is tightened to the exact COMPLETED_WORK_LATE_FINDING_REFUSAL. RED logs/38b, GREEN logs/39c and 39d; final sequence logs/42 all pass. Documented in matrix row B49.
